intent: A panel anchored to a trigger. Click opens it. Escape and a click outside close it.
useWhen: A small panel of content or actions anchored to a button
Something that should not take over the page the way a Modal does
Which one: Tooltip names a control in a few words; HelpPopover explains it in one to three sentences; Popover holds fields or actions and takes focus. None of them is a menu or a blocking decision.
doNotUseWhen: One or two sentences of help — use HelpPopover
A menu of commands — use DropdownMenu

trigger.note: One focusable control. Click toggles the panel.

title.note: Heading at the top of the panel, 18px at heading weight. eyebrow and tone show only with a title. label still names the dialog.

eyebrow.note: Short area name above the title, 12px, like Billing · Invoices. Caller-provided.

tone.note: Tone icon (16px, aria-hidden) and status word from KitLabels before the eyebrow, so status is never colour alone. Same header as Modal.

footer.note: kit Buttons, size sm, bottom right. At most one appearance=solid mode=primary.

footerStart.note: Left of the footer actions: an Ask Button (outline neutral sm, MessageCircle) or a count. Labels are caller-provided.

placement.note: Preferred side. Lines up with the trigger's start edge, flips when there is no room and stays inside the viewport.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Trigger gets aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, and aria-controls
Panel is role=dialog and labelled by label
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
A pointer down outside the trigger and the panel closes it
Focus moves to the first field on open; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the panel until Escape or a click outside

doNot: Do not use Popover for help text — use HelpPopover
Do not use Popover as a date or select menu — use DatePicker, DateRangePicker, or Select
Do not add a Close button, scrim or page lock — Escape and a click outside close it; use Modal for a blocking decision
snippet: <Popover label="Share" trigger={<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral">Share</Button>}>Copy the link.</Popover>
